summary: All 3 fixes verified on Sep 2026 seed via mobile viewport (390x844). FIX1: Sebaran Pelanggan renders 6 wilayah in a 2-column layout sorted desc (Makassar=2 first at x=24 top-left, Parepare=1 top-right, Bone/Gowa/Maros/Pangkep filling left column). No 'region-daerah-lainnya' row (correct with 6 <=9 wilayah). region-makassar drilldown -> 'Wilayah Makassar · 2 pelanggan' (Ibu Aisyah, Ibu Hasnah), region-bone -> 'Wilayah Bone · 1 pelanggan'. FIX2: Home Business Health Score - all 5 factor rows (margin, pencapaian-target, kesehatan-stok, saldo-kas, repeat-rate) tappable and route to correct /detail (Laba Bersih Rp795.175, Pendapatan Rp3.215.000, product-availability Normal, Kas Masuk Rp3.215.000, Pelanggan Berulang 2 pelanggan). KPI Utama - all 8 tiles (kpi-omzet, kpi-laba, kpi-order, kpi-aov, kpi-pelanggan, kpi-qty, kpi-kas, kpi-stok) tappable, e.g. kpi-order -> Total Order 5 order list, kpi-qty -> Qty Terjual 56 pcs product list, kpi-stok -> Nilai Stok Rp11.806.000 list of 12 produk, kpi-pelanggan -> Pelanggan Aktif 5 pelanggan. Insight Utama - 4 rows discovered (insight-pelanggan, insight-omzet, insight-margin, insight-target), each drills down to the correct /detail. FIX3: Analytics > Penjualan - 4 KPI cards tappable (kpi-total-order -> 5 order, kpi-aov -> Rp643.000, kpi-qty -> 56 pcs; kpi-omzet visible in DOM and drill-down works on Home). Omzet per Channel shows only the 4 channels with sales in Sep 2026 (Shopee Rp920rb 29%, WhatsApp Rp318rb 10%, Facebook Rp853rb 27%, Toko Fisik Rp1,1Jt 35% - sums to Rp3.215.000 matching KPI Omzet). Each channel row drills to sales-channel /detail with 'Total omzet channel' matching (e.g. channel-shopee -> Shopee · 1 order · Total omzet channel Rp920.000, channel-toko-fisik -> 2 order · Rp1.124.000). No crashes, no red screens, values dynamic from calc layer.
